SET LOCAL search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp

DO $$ BEGIN IF current_database() <> 'neondb' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unexpected database'; END IF; IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.alembic_version) <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.alembic_version WHERE version_num='0026_queue_reenroll') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unexpected schema revision or database'; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='hmi_migrator') OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='hmi_app') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dedicated roles required'; END IF; IF (SELECT nspowner FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname='public') IS DISTINCT FROM 'hmi_migrator'::regrole::oid OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_class WHERE oid=to_regclass('public.alembic_version') AND relowner='hmi_migrator'::regrole::oid AND relkind='r') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dedicated migrator ownership required'; END IF; END $$
